targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Weight",
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 42 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Body Fat",
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 49 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Muscle",
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 43 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "BMI",
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 44 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Lean Mass",
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 507 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Hydration"

SELECT dps.recorded_at AS time, dps.value AS "Weight"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY dps.recorded_at

SELECT dps.recorded_at AS time, dps.value AS "Body Fat %"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 42
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY dps.recorded_at

SELECT now() AS time,
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  -
  (SELECT value FROM data_point_series dps JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59' AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41 AND recorded_at <= now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  AS "Weight Change"
